settings.enabled.label: Enable lyrics
settings.enabled.description: Show the 3D lyrics overlay while music is playing.
settings.font_size.label: Font size
settings.font_size.description: Base size of lyric lines in pixels.
settings.font_family.label: Font family
settings.font_family.description: Optional font family; leave blank for the Noctalia UI font.
settings.font_weight.label: Font weight
settings.font_weight.description: Weight of the active lyric line.
settings.line_spacing.label: Line spacing
settings.max_lines.label: Maximum lines
settings.max_lines.description: How many lyric lines the 3D scene can show.
settings.width_percent.label: Scene width
settings.width_percent.description: Width of the 3D scene as a fraction of the monitor.
settings.angle_x.label: X rotation
settings.angle_y.label: Y rotation
settings.angle_z.label: Z rotation
settings.scene_scale.label: Scene scale
settings.scene_scale.description: Overall scale of the 3D lyric plane.
settings.offset_x.label: Horizontal offset
settings.offset_x.description: Move the scene left or right in pixels.
settings.offset_y.label: Vertical offset
settings.offset_y.description: Fine-tune the scene position in pixels.
settings.dynamic_placement.label: Dynamic placement
settings.dynamic_placement.description: Move the type block between safe screen zones when each new lyric line starts.
settings.wallpaper_aware.label: Wallpaper-aware placement
settings.wallpaper_aware.description: Analyse the wallpaper once and keep the lyrics on its calmest area; recomputed only when the wallpaper changes.
settings.center_safe_zone.label: Center safe zone
settings.center_safe_zone.description: Percentage of the screen centre kept free for the wallpaper's main subject.
settings.display_mode.label: Lyrics display mode
settings.display_mode.description: Choose how the active lyric is staged; Auto adapts to line length and timing.
settings.position_preset.label: Alignment preset
settings.position_preset.description: Quickly align the lyric block; choose Custom to use the sliders.
settings.position_x.label: Horizontal position
settings.position_x.description: Horizontal position of the lyric block, 0% (left) to 100% (right).
settings.position_y.label: Vertical position
settings.position_y.description: Vertical position of the lyric block, 0% (top) to 100% (bottom).
settings.show_now_playing.label: Now playing header
settings.show_now_playing.description: Show the cover, title and artist pill above the lyrics.
settings.show_next_line.label: Preview next line
settings.show_next_line.description: Dimly show the next lyric line below the active type block.
settings.now_playing_position.label: Now playing position
settings.now_playing_position.descriptio: Pin the compact now-playing card below the bar or in a top corner.
settings.typography_style.label: Typography style
settings.typography_style.description: Display style for the kinetic lyric words.
settings.typography_max_width.label: Type block width
settings.typography_max_width.descriptio: Maximum width of the packed lyric block in pixels (420–520).
settings.depth_scale.label: Depth spacing
settings.depth_scale.description: Distance between lyric lines in depth.
settings.blur_amount.label: Depth blur
settings.blur_amount.description: Blur applied to lines that are far from the focal plane.
settings.active_glow.label: Active glow
settings.active_glow.description: Glow strength for the current lyric line.
settings.parallax.label: Mouse parallax
settings.parallax.description: Let the scene follow the pointer with a subtle parallax.
settings.parallax_strength.label: Parallax strength
settings.parallax_strength.description: How strongly the scene reacts to pointer movement.
settings.sync_offset.label: Sync offset
settings.filter_mode.label: Source filter
settings.filter_mode.description: Which browser or media sources may show lyrics.
settings.disabled_domains.label: Disabled domains
settings.disabled_domains.description: Domains that must never trigger lyrics.
settings.custom_domains.label: Custom domains
settings.custom_domains.description: Extra domains treated as valid media sources.
settings.disabled_players.label: Disabled players
settings.allowed_windows.label: Allowed windows
settings.allowed_windows.description: Window classes that keep lyrics visible. One class per entry.
settings.visibility_mode.label: Visibility
settings.visibility_mode.description: When the desktop layer is shown.
settings.hide_on_fullscreen.label: Hide on fullscreen
settings.hide_on_fullscreen.description: Hide lyrics when a window is fullscreen.
settings.monitor_scope.label: Monitors
settings.monitor_scope.description: Draw on the focused output only, or on every output.
settings.theme_mode.label: Colour mode
settings.theme_mode.description: Choose colours from the wallpaper, the album art, or your own palette.
settings.accent_blend.label: Accent blend
settings.accent_blend.description: Mix between the base palette and the accent colour.
settings.custom_text_color.label: Text colour
settings.custom_text_color.description: Text colour used in custom mode.
settings.custom_accent_color.label: Accent colour
settings.custom_accent_color.description: Highlight colour used in custom mode.
settings.text_scrim.label: Text scrim
settings.text_scrim.description: Dark backing behind lyric text for readability.
settings.wallpaper_path_override.label: Wallpaper override
settings.wallpaper_path_override.descrip: Optional image used for colour analysis instead of the current wallpaper.
settings.show_plain_lyrics.label: Plain lyrics fallback
settings.show_plain_lyrics.description: Show unsynced lyrics when LRCLIB has no timed version.
settings.cache_enabled.label: Cache lyrics
settings.save_perspectives.label: Save per-wallpaper perspective
settings.save_perspectives.description: Remember X/Y/Z angles for each wallpaper in perspectives.json.
settings.hide_on_pause.label: Hide on pause
settings.hide_on_pause.description: Fade the lyrics out 1.5 s after playback pauses and bring them back the moment it resumes.
settings.wallpaper_order.label: Roaming order
settings.wallpaper_order.description: Order in which the calm wallpaper spots are visited.
